suggestions.title: Gardening advice
suggestions.description: A practical explainer on a gardening technique, topic or seasonal task, written to help readers look after or plan their own gardens.
suggestions.why: Five entries (mulch, late-winter pruning, winter structure, rain gardens, October jobs) teach a method or set of tasks in a friendly, explanatory voice, aimed at readers' own gardens rather than a Northfold project.

suggestions.title: Project story
suggestions.description: A write-up of a garden Northfold has designed or reworked, describing the site, its constraints, what was done and how it has turned out.
suggestions.why: Four entries (Tyne Valley hillside, Gateshead playground, Calder Street courtyard, Hexham walled garden) are each titled after a named place and open with the site's particular conditions before telling the story of the work.

suggestions.title: Studio news
suggestions.description: A short announcement about Northfold itself, such as a move to new premises or a new member of staff, to keep clients and followers up to date.
suggestions.why: Two entries (the move to Wharf Lane and Priya Raman joining) announce a change at the studio in a news-style opening that states the fact first and then gives background.
